_readme: Copy to <VIDEO_NOTES_RUNTIME_DIR>/config/whisper_models.json (default ~/.cache/video-notes-generator/config/). tiers are ordered candidate chains: the script tries each in turn and degrades loudly on failure. When selecting the high tier, check tiers_updated; if older than 6 months or missing, web-search current faster-whisper model recommendations, update tiers and the date, then run. Only this file changes when new models appear — SKILL.md stays tier-only.
